Harvard University Department of Music

The Music Department offers both undergraduate and graduate programs. Additionally, the department sponsors numerous concerts, colloquia, lectures and special music events each month, which are free to students and the public.

See Upcoming Events arrow_circle_right

Practice Rooms

The Department of Music practice rooms are available on a first come, first served basis to members of the Harvard community.
